02 — The DNA

Drive your story home with the right soundtrack.

It's what lands your message into people's hearts, leaping right over barriers of language, race, preferences and outlooks.

When you reach people on the ground of shared human truths, you've found yourself in golden territory.

03 — The Impact

A sonic ring of composers, writers, editors, mixers & masters.

01

02

05 — The Offering

What we score.

01

Film Scoring

Got your movie ready for its soundtrack soulmate, or a script that's ready to be filmed? We'll craft a score to set your story ablaze in viewers' hearts.

02

TV & Advert Scoring

Now loading: sounds that sell. Make your ad un-skippable with music that hooks listeners and stops them mid-scroll or channel surf.

03

Theme Songs

Those theme songs that give you chills and make you ignore "skip intro"? Let's cook one up for your show — and hit the streaming charts too.

04

Podcast & Audio Branding

You can probably hum your favourite podcast's theme right now. Let's build that kind of memorable audio branding for your podcast, app or service.

05

Social & Sound Design

Your social content and campaigns deserve to be entered into those award categories — including sound design and music. Let's make it audio-on by default.

06

Niche & Local Genres

Authentic music in localised genres is tough to find on a good day. We offer original music with a distinct African feel — Amapiano, Afrobeats and more.

06 — The Team

Driven by music, in one form or another.

"770GB iTunes library and counting — music-obsessed since day one on planet Earth."

Nicolas Gonzalez

Composer / Producer

Physical media nerd. Wild genre-hopper. Mild coffee addict. From alt-rock band Climate Control (2008) to solo indie project Raptors & Remnants, Nic puts his writing and production experience to work telling stories with sound.

Creative Director / Producer
